content: Hi all! I will have to do a poster about the formalization of E-Values (in collaboration with @Rémy Degenne). This is the first time I’ve had to design a poster like this, and I was looking for a bit of inspiration. If any of you would like to share your posters on the formalization of any topic, I’d love to see them!
Feel free to have a look at this formalization poster. (general audience, some technical simplifications to be expected)
You can take a look at the poster I made on formalizing the GNS construction here: https://lean.nyc/assets/files/formalizing-the-gns-construction-in-lean-poster.pdf
